items.stem: Each of the following is associated with the Reagan presidency EXCEPT
options: trickle-down economics
New Federalism
the Whitewater scandal
Star Wars
items.explanation: The Whitewater scandal occurred during the 1990s and involved questionable real-estate dealings by President Clinton. “Trickle-down” theory was Reagan’s economic policy involving corporate tax cuts and New Federalism was his plan to shift federal power to the states. “Star Wars” refers to the Strategic Defense Initiative (SDI), a space-based missile shield program proposed by Reagan as a means of protecting the United States against a nuclear attack by the Soviet Union.

items.stem: In his 1985 State of the Union Address, Ronald Reagan articulated his foreign policy goals in what has come to be known as the Reagan Doctrine. Like Truman, Reagan pledged to
options: support anti-communist resistance movements, particularly in the Third World
sponsor covert military operations to overthrow communist regimes in Eastern Europe
ease tensions between the Soviet Union and the United States
broker a peace agreement between the Palestinians and the Israelis
items.explanation: There are several presidential doctrines you should know for this exam—for example, the Monroe Doctrine and the Truman Doctrine. In most cases, these “doctrines” were delivered as speeches to Congress but became statements of U.S. foreign policy. Alarmed by the establishment of Soviet satellites in Eastern Europe and the potential Soviet threat to Greece and Turkey following World War II, Truman pledged his support to prevent the spread of communism in Europe (although he did not use those exact words). As a cold warrior, Ronald Reagan was committed to providing covert and overt assistance to anti-communist resistance movements, particularly in nations like Afghanistan and Nicaragua.

items.explanation: This is a factoid question. President George H. W. Bush led the brief Persian Gulf War in 1990. Choice (B) is Carter, (D) is Reagan, and (A) is President Clinton.

items.stem: Which of the following actions by the Clinton administration was most harmonious with Liberal Democrat values?
options: Military peacekeeping interventions in the Balkans and Somalia
Welfare benefit reform to encourage young mothers to reenter the work force
Free trade agreements such as NAFTA and GATT
The effort to pass a universal health care legislation in the Congress
items.explanation: Liberal Democrats would have mixed feelings about war and free trade, so rule out (A) and (C). Welfare benefit reform was in fact designed to get young mothers off welfare, so this was not necessarily a boon to the Democrats. The most ambitious effort by the Clinton administration was to pass a universal health care bill, but this ultimately did not pass Congress.

items.stem: For the U.S. military and the national defense industry, the consequences of the September 11 terrorist attacks did NOT include
options: facing further large-scale attacks on U.S. soil
the launch of two prolonged wars in the Middle East
the establishment of the Department of Homeland Security
a series of long-term investigations into the causes of the attack
items.explanation: The U.S. military and the defense industry were transformed by the September 11 attacks. First, they cooperated with Congress in investigating the causes and funding of the terrorist attacks, so eliminate (D). At the same time, Congress forced the defense industry to consolidate itself under the umbrella of the new Department of Homeland Security, founded in 2002, which pushed together approximately 20 different smaller defense and intelligence groups. Eliminate (C). Most significantly, the Bush administration launched two enormously expensive wars in the Middle East—one in Afghanistan, one in Iraq. Eliminate (B). However, there were never any more major attacks on U.S. soil by Islamic radicals, so select (A).
